row:
Castoff Pet Rescue is a nonprofit, no-kill organization serving Union and Towns Counties in Georgia, Clay and Cherokee Counties in North Carolina, and anywhere else our help is needed. We are a 501(c)(3) licensed by the Georgia Department of Agriculture, and we receive no public funding.

Every life we save depends on the generosity of donors, adopters, volunteers, and the community that stands with us. Since our beginnings in 2006, when a handful of volunteers fostered in their homes and later transformed an old boarding kennel into our first shelter,  thousands of animals have found safety, love, and forever homes through Castoff.
